Then you should include <wireshark.h>

See doc.README.dissector and doc/packet-PROTOABBREV.c

This tracking of the captured data makes the code less readable and will result in an incomplete presentation to the user. It's better just to keep adding proto items and let the tvbuff handle any potential overruns, which it is designed to do gracefully just for this reason.
